title: Image Specification Schema
description: Schema for AI-generated image specifications using NanoBanana

generate.description: Whether to generate this image via AI. Set to false to use override/fallback only.

id.description: Unique identifier for the image. Used as filename (without extension).

prompt.description: Text prompt describing the image to generate. Be specific about style, colors, composition.

style.description: Predefined style preset that sets default resolution and aspect ratio.

format.description: Output image format. WebP recommended for best compression.

resolution.description: Output resolution. Higher = more detail but higher cost.

aspectRatio.description: Aspect ratio override. If not set, uses style preset default.

fallback.description: Path to fallback image if generation fails. Relative to assets directory.

override.description: Path to client-provided image that takes precedence over generation. Relative to assets directory.

alt.description: Alt text for accessibility. Auto-generated from prompt if not provided.

tags.description: Tags for organizing and filtering images in the manifest.
